message.content: {"evidence":"The temporary-offset hypothesis (gray curve) aligns the segment between J1 and J2 with the pre-J1 trend in all three axes, while the permanent-step hypothesis leaves a residual offset after J1 and the isolated-point hypothesis fails to correct the sustained excursion; interior observations between J1 and J2 consistently follow the shifted trajectory, supporting a genuine temporary displacement.","pair_ids":["P1"]}
